scheme.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
scheme.implementing_agency: Banks, Post Offices, LIC and other life insurance companies
scheme.description: One-year renewable term life insurance offering Rs 2 lakh cover for death due to any reason. Annual premium Rs 436/-. Cover period 1 June to 31 May. Entry age 18-50 years, cover continues up to age 55. Lien period of 30 days for non-accidental deaths for new/rejoining subscribers. Administered through LIC and other life insurance companies via participating Banks/Post Offices.
scheme.voice_summary: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana is life insurance of 2 lakh rupees for people aged 18 to 50 with a bank account. The premium is 436 rupees a year.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh on death due to any reason
eligibility: Age must be 18 years (completed) or above
Age must not exceed 50 years (age nearer birthday)
Must have a bank or post office savings account
Aadhaar is primary KYC for bank account
exceptions: Persons below 18 years or above 50 years of age (risk cover ends at age 55)

faqs.question: What is the premium and life insurance coverage under PMJJBY?
faqs.answer: PMJJBY provides life insurance cover of Rs. 2,00,000 in case of death due to any reason. The annual premium is Rs. 436 per annum, auto-debited from the subscriber's bank account in May/June.

catalog_descriptions.en: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana is life insurance of 2 lakh rupees for people aged 18 to 50 with a bank account. The premium is 436 rupees a year.
catalog_descriptions.hi: प्रधानमंत्री जीवन ज्योति बीमा योजना 18 से 50 वर्ष की आयु के लोगों के लिए 2 लाख रुपये का जीवन बीमा है। प्रीमियम 436 रुपये प्रति वर्ष है।
catalog_descriptions.ta: பிஎம் ஜீவன் ஜோதி பீமா யோஜனா என்பது வங்கிக் கணக்கு வைத்திருக்கும் 18 முதல் 50 வயதுக்குட்பட்டவர்களுக்கு 2 லட்சம் ரூபாய் ஆயுள் காப்பீட்டு திட்டமாகும். பிரீமியம் தொகை ஆண்டுக்கு 436 ரூபாய் ஆகும்.
